sentences.text: Follow a single photon from the sun.
Eight minutes after leaving the sun, it strikes a silicon solar cell.
Its energy knocks an electron loose, and leaves behind a hole.
The electric field at the p-n junction sweeps them apart. That is direct current.
Cells are strung into modules, and modules into arrays.
An inverter shapes the DC into clean, 60 hertz AC.
The battery, the generator, and the utility grid join the same bus.
Power then flows through the UPS and the PDUs, to redundant supplies in every server.
On a GPU, electrons become arithmetic.
Tensor cores switch billions of times a second, multiplying model weights against your prompt.
Layer after layer, a probability distribution emerges, and the next token is chosen.
Then the next. And the next.
Sunlight, electrons, floating point operations, tokens. REPACSS makes that chain visible, and measurable.
